peer_summary: The exact V3.1 policy materially repairs the V3 defects in static-allowlist projection, 13/8/5 governed-operation separation, staged size/hash binding, dot-root representation, exact graph closure, current/controller executable identity and hash continuity, declared partial-snapshot rejection, prepare recomputation, and authority nonclaims. The hashed 17-function direct semantic suite passes in full. The draft still cannot qualify: it accepts evidence observed after the checker claims completion; accepts canonical parent identities on another volume and a governed file identity aliased to its parent; treats bounded-snapshot completeness as asserted status rather than evidence the policy can calculate; accepts grossly inconsistent interphase wall-versus-monotonic elapsed time without a same-lease identity or whole-lease bound; and accepts fractionless-float drift across supposedly exact prepare/publish continuity even when the two continuity hashes differ. These are fresh deterministic counterexamples against the exact hashes, not requests for live or canonical action.

affirmed_repairs.evidence: The policy binds the exact static-allowlist SHA-256, exact target and sentinel projection hashes, closed nested source/normalization/count projections, exact order, roles, operations, parents and leaves. The replay observed 13 governed targets, eight replacements, five guard-only rows at ordinals 4, 6, 9, 11 and 13, and three sentinels. A target-role substitution was rejected.

The freeze binds allowlist preimage and staged hashes and sizes, and a plus-one staged-size mutation was rejected with freeze file allowlist projection drift. Finding T550-V9-V3-1-POLICY-PEER-005 separately addresses raw-record numeric typing and cross-phase exact-continuity comparison.

The dot parent must equal the frozen model identity, root sentinels and the receipts one-component parent pass, and a swapped dot-parent identity is rejected. Finding T550-V9-V3-1-POLICY-PEER-002 addresses the still-unclosed nonroot parent/file identity topology.

The graph contains the exact 20 sorted nodes and exact dependency tuples, rejects extra nodes and changed back-edges, rejects missing dependencies, and calculates cycle closure. Because dependency tuples are exact, no caller-supplied cycle can be admitted without first failing the exact-edge check.

Frozen current and controller roles, normalized names, file identities, nonzero sizes and SHA-256 values are structurally bound and compared exactly to both phase snapshots. A current executable hash drift was rejected.

PARTIAL status, declared omission, PID reuse, unclassified names, liveness/access uncertainty and an included unrelated OneDrive writer are rejected. Finding T550-V9-V3-1-POLICY-PEER-003 addresses an omitted row that is not disclosed by the supplied record.

Publish requires independently supplied canonical prepare raw/result bytes and detached hashes, reparses and revalidates the prepare raw record, exactly recomputes the prepare result, binds the publish causal parent, and rejects an authorization-bit substitution.

Both green prepare and publish fixtures remain explicitly machine-only: human identity, owner capability, opaque lease and reviewed-release origin are false or unverified; all replace, effect, publication and completion authorizations are false; canonical execution is blocked; hidden-writer exclusion is false; candidate_only and non_authorizing are true; and all four machine blockers are retained.

findings.title: Checker can finish before the evidence it claims to have checked is observed
findings.evidence: Each file/process observation is required only to fall inside the outer capture. Checker start/end are also required only to fall inside that capture, and checked_evidence_sha256 is content-bound, but no rule requires all hashed observations to occur no later than checker completion. A fresh fixture placed every target, sentinel and process observation at capture second 9 while checker completion remained at second 7. After recomputing the raw evidence digest, the exact policy returned machine_preconditions_pass true.
findings.risk: The raw record can assert a temporally impossible checker attestation. This violates the normative causal-order repair and leaves checker/collector chronology underconstrained.
findings.required_repair: Require every observation contributing to checked_evidence_sha256 to occur before or at checker completion on both clocks, define whether observations may precede checker start, and add after-checker file, sentinel and process negatives.

findings.title: Nonroot parent and governed-file identity topology is not closed to the model root
findings.evidence: The exact dot parent is correctly equal to model_identity, but the three nonroot parent identities need only be distinct from each other and the model identity. Their volume_serial values are not required to equal the frozen model volume, and no retained-handle descendant relation is represented. File identity uniqueness is checked only across target/sentinel files, not against roots or parents. Two fresh fixtures passed: one moved hos-book-chunks-parent from model volume 77 to volume 999 while preserving all asserted fields; the other gave a governed file the same (volume_serial,file_id) key as its parent while changing only directory/file attributes.
findings.risk: Exact logical path tokens do not prove that the measured parent handles are descendants of the frozen model root or that a governed file identity is disjoint from its directory parent. The policy therefore does not calculate the non-escaping rooted identity topology required by the V3 rejection.
findings.required_repair: Bind volume consistency for volume/workspace/model/canonical parents/governed files, require handle-derived parent-chain relations from model root to every nonroot parent, and reject identity-key aliasing across roots, parents, governed files and sentinels.

findings.title: Bounded process completeness remains asserted rather than calculable from supplied evidence
findings.evidence: The policy checks that declared bounded counts equal the number of supplied bounded rows and that status/count failure fields claim no omission. It receives no full system-process classification projection from which bounded_candidate_count can be independently calculated. A fresh fixture increased system_process_count from 500 to 1,000,000 while retaining only the current/controller rows, bounded counts of two and COMPLETE/NONE statuses. The exact policy returned machine_preconditions_pass true.
findings.risk: The policy cannot distinguish a genuinely complete bounded set from a record that silently omitted a bounded writer and asserted COMPLETE. This repeats the substance of affirmed V3 finding POLICY-X-006. The result honestly keeps hidden_writer_exclusion_proven false, so this is not an authority overclaim, but it remains an implementation/component qualification hold.
findings.required_repair: Supply a closed, independently classifiable full-enumeration projection or another review-approved completeness proof bound to the trusted collector, calculate the bounded subset inside policy, and preserve fail-closed handling for inaccessible, exited, ambiguous and unclassified entries.

findings.title: Prepare/publish dual-clock chronology is order-only and lacks same-lease identity and whole-lease bounds
findings.evidence: Capture duration compares wall and monotonic elapsed time, but interphase chronology checks only nondecreasing order on each clock. No shared lease token exists, no overall prepare-start-to-publish-validation maximum is enforced, and the wall/monotonic interphase elapsed values are not compared. A fresh publish fixture passed with 3,589 wall-clock seconds but only nine monotonic seconds between prepare validation and publish capture start. machine_preconditions_pass was true while opaque_lease_verified_by_pure_policy remained false.
findings.risk: The policy can label phase chronology green across mutually inconsistent clocks and without proving the same live lease required by the normative V3 repair. Honest lease nonverification prevents authorization but does not qualify the machine gate.
findings.required_repair: Bind both phases to one opaque lease identity supplied by the production wrapper, enforce a whole-lease maximum, compare interphase wall/monotonic elapsed values within a documented tolerance, and add skewed-clock and stale-lease negatives.

findings.title: Raw integer fields and cross-phase continuity admit numeric representation drift
findings.evidence: Several raw sizes, link counts, snapshot counts and selected PID fields are compared to integers with Python numeric equality rather than validated with _integer. The prepare/publish continuity check compares Python objects rather than their canonical hashes. Fractionless floats for snapshot count/PID fields passed prepare. A publish fixture then changed target preimage/staged size fields, size/link fields, sentinel size/link fields and most snapshot count/PID fields from integers to equal-valued floats. Publish passed even though prepare continuity_sha256 f7e67d01e55912e8a0e20929f2bd70628f603a3035590468181c5e17551f48b0 differed from publish continuity_sha256 f69f6c9c211e06eb72834f0d2ad6f4d6ed7e805a0077c9164eca9154f0e19c1b.
findings.risk: The claimed exact typed continuity is weaker than the canonical evidence hashes and can admit schema drift across phases. The numeric values do not change, so this is lower severity than the causal and topology findings, but it defeats exact canonical continuity.
findings.required_repair: Apply _integer to every integer-valued raw/snapshot field and compare canonical continuity bytes or continuity_sha256 values rather than Python object equality. Add integer-to-float drift negatives for staged sizes, link counts, counts and selected PIDs.

direct_semantic_reproduction.execution_method: Imported the exact hashed test module with bytecode writing disabled and invoked each test_* function directly.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The V3.1 pure policy is materially safer and more semantically closed than rejected V3.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Exact allowlist projections, staged values, guarded nonreplacement rows, dot-root identity, exact DAG, executable identity/hash, declared snapshot negatives, prepare recomputation and authority nonclaims are real repairs.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The test-only/direct semantic evidence is useful even without formal pytest.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: All 17 exact test functions passed when called directly, but the fresh accepted counterexamples show the test set is not qualification-complete.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Caller or trusted-collector discipline can make asserted parent topology, snapshot completeness and observation chronology true in production.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The corrected gate requires deterministic fail-closed evidence. A future trusted collector may supply new fields, retained-handle facts and completeness proofs, but the exact current policy accepts contradictory or underdetermined records.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Fractionless JSON numbers are mathematically equal even when Python renders one as a float.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The policy itself uses explicit integer validators elsewhere and emits canonical continuity hashes. Accepting cross-phase records whose canonical continuity hashes differ contradicts the exact typed continuity claim.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even a repaired bounded-process proof cannot exclude every pre-opened, future, hidden, kernel, sync, ancestor-thread or noncooperating writer, nor eliminate precheck-to-rename lost update and post-readback stale-state races.
